senses.gloss:
Bhoga
śaiva upāgama in Vimalāgama. See list in Kāmikāgama.

Bhogakarman_Kāśmīra
or Bhogivarman. poet. See Skm. [Page266a] p. 179 of Lahore edn.; v. 1318 of Calcutta edn.; in Sbhv. v. 1825.

Bhogakārikā
A metrical work in one hundred an. forty-one verses on the nature of material enjoyments an. the means of attaining them; by Sadyojyotiḥ.
q. by Jayaratna in his C. on Tantrāloka, Vol. VI., Kas. Texts. 29. p.. 132. 195.
Adyar D. X. 841-42. French Inst. III. 301/ 6. 301/13. Mysore I. p. 543. Mysore N. D. XII. 40790-91. Extr. p. 38.
-C. Vṛtti by Aghoraśivācārya, disciple of Vidyākaṇṭha, disciple of Rāmakaṇṭha. Adyar II. p. 176a. Adyar D. X. 841. Bumell 111a. French Inst. III. 301/13. Mysore 4. Mysore I. p. 543 (2 mss.). Mysore N. D. XII. 40790. 40791. Extr. p. 38. 40792. Extr. p.. 38-39. TD. 8190.
Pt.. (1) Aṣṭaprakaraṇa edn. Vol. I. Śaivāgama Siddhānta Paripālana Sangham, Devakottai, 1925.
-C. by Rāmakaṇṭha Bhaṭṭa, son of Nārāyaṇakaṇṭha. Adyar D. X. 842.

Bhogacandra
Epi. Ind. XXIII. 161.

Bhoganātha
brother of Mādhavācārya (a. of Jaiminīyanyāyamālā, Adyar D. IX. 134); an. of Sāyaṇa. q. in Alaṅkārasudhānidhi, attributed to Sāyaṇa, See ABORI. Golden Jubilee Vol.. XLVIII an. XLIX. p. 276.
Chamberlain of King Saṅgama II. He was the a. of Biṭraguṇṭa Copper Plates. See Uṭṭaṅkita Śilāśāsana, I. p.. 74. 79. 83. [Page266b]
See M. P. L. Sastri. Bhoganātha-a poet of the 14th century, IHQ. XVII-3. 1941. p.. 393-97.
-Udāharaṇamālā. See under the text.
-Gaurīnāthāṣṭaka. See under the text.
-Gadyacūḍāmaṇi.
-Tripuravijaya.
-Mahāgaṇapatistava.
-Mūṣikāṣṭaka.
-Śṛṅgāramañjarī.
See ABORI. Golden Jubilee XLVIII an. XLIX. p. 275; M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 125; also see P. Sriramamurti, Cont. of Andhra to Skt. Lit., p.. 101-02.

Bhoganirṇaya
work cited by Madhva, not extant. See BNK. Sharma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. Vol. I. p. 356.

Bhoganivedanavidhi
SB. New D.. II. iv. 66847.

Bhogabhūpati
Āyurveda. SB. New D.. XII. ii. 108416. (inc.).

Bhogamokṣa
q. by Rāmakaṇṭha in his Nareśvara parīkṣāvyākhyā, Kashmir Series, 45. p. 108.

Bhogamokṣaprakaraṇa
tantra. Mysore N. D. XVI. ii. 50110. Extr. p. 25.

Bhogamokṣapradīpikā
by Utpala. q. by him in Spandapradīpikā.

Bhogalakṣaṇa
Mysore N. D. XIII. 42192 (inc.). [Page267a]

Bhogalapurāṇa
Jaipur Mus. Ser. 2. p. 75. VVBISIS. I. 1588.

Bhoga(la)lāśāsra
(Pkt.). BP. p. 184b.

Bhogavatī
on Pkt. metres. by Tulasīdāsa, son of Murāri Śukla. Oudh XI, 10.

Bhogavatībhāgyodaya
by Śaṅkaralāla, son of Maheśvara of Bhāradvājagotra. See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 733.

Bhogaśaktisthāpanavidhi
also known a. Bhogāṅgaśaktisthāpanavidhi. French Inst. IV. 386/ 38. 391/53.

Bhogaśailamāhātmya
Bik. 1641.

Bhogasaṅkrāntividhi
from Bhaviṣyottarapurāṇa. Ben. 55.

Bhogasamarpaṇaślokāḥ
by Viṭṭhaleśvara. Udaipur II. 130. 9 (35).

Bhogasārakathā
Saurashtra p. 75.

Bhogahīnaphalanirṇaya
Mysore N. D. XV. 46876.

Bhogāṅgaśaktisthāpanavidhi
or Bhogaśaktisthāpanavidhi. See above.

Bhogāṅgārcanavidhi
from Sūkṣmāgama. worship of the attendant deities of Śiva. French Inst. I. 92/33. Viśvabhāratī 1998.

Bhogāditya
Epi. Ind. X. 100.

Bhogāpasāraṇaśloka
Udaipur II. 129. 97 (2 v..). [Page267b]
-by Vallabha. Udaipur II. 132, 9 (120; 2 v..).

Bhogāvalī
stotra on Ekāmreśvara of Kāñcī recited a. a meeting of the Sabhā of the temple in Śaka 1453; by Śrīnivāsadikṣita, son of Sītārāma. See Epi. Ind. XXXIII. p.. 199-200.
-C. Vṛtti. Oppert II. 4811.

Bhoginī_Daśā
jy. CPB. 3725.

Bhogin
father of Veṇīdatta (a. of C. Bhāvārthadīpikā on Śataślokī, TD. 11141).

Bhogivarman
See under Bhogakarman.

Bhogiśailamāhātmya
from Skandapurāṇa. Jodhpur 752. RORI. III. A. 2072-73. 2074 (inc.). XXIV. 478.

Bhogīndra
son of Narendra; a. ancestor of Kṣemendra (a. of Daśāvatāracarita).

Bhogīndra
(prob. Patañjalī). mentioned by Maheśvara in his Viśvaprakāśa, Oxf. 188a.

Bhogīparvan
by Nirbhayarāṃabhaṭṭa.
Pt.. Bṛhatstotrasaritsāgara, Gujarati News Press, Bombay, 1927. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938. p. 449.

Bhogīrāmātmaja
prob. Bāhurāma.
-Sūtravṛtti. BHU. 1203.

Bhogīśvara
ref. to by Viṭṭhalapaṇḍita in his Vāgbhaṭamaṇḍana. Bomb. Uni. 227. [Page268a]

Bhogīśvara
son of Sarvadeva.
-Yogaratnapradīpikā. Adyar D. VIII. 89-92. Lonavla 889 (5 mss.; 4 inc.).

Bhogopasorātirṇaya
NPS. II. p. 520.

Bhogyāṃśa
jy. (sic). RORI. X. 2144.
